Iran FM: No Direct US Talks, Messages Via Intermediaries

Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi stated that there have been no direct talks between Iran and the United States. He clarified that communication between the two nations has occurred solely through intermediaries. This statement was made by the Iranian FM.
